dish.title: Hungarian Chicken Paprikash with Buttered Egg Noodles and Cucumber Salad
dish.description: Bone-in chicken thighs browned and braised in a velvety sauce of slow-cooked onions, sweet Hungarian paprika, tomato, and pepper, finished with tangy sour cream. Served over buttered egg noodles with a cool, vinegary cucumber salad.

recipe_version.title: Hungarian Chicken Paprikash with Buttered Egg Noodles and Cucumber Salad
recipe_version.description: Bone-in chicken thighs browned and braised in a velvety sauce of slow-cooked onions, sweet Hungarian paprika, tomato, and pepper, finished with tangy sour cream. Served over buttered egg noodles with a cool, vinegary cucumber salad.

ingredients.name: Hungarian wax pepper
ingredients.display_name: Hungarian wax pepper or green bell pepper

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 1 1/2 tsp chicken and sauce, 1 tsp noodles, 1/2 tsp cucumbers

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Season the chicken with 1 tsp salt and the pepper. Dice the onions, slice the pepper, and chop the tomato and parsley. Thinly slice the cucumbers. Put 16 cups (4 quarts) water on to boil for the noodles in the 6- to 8-quart pot.

steps.title: Brown the chicken
steps.body: Heat the oil in the braiser over medium-high and sear the chicken until golden on both sides, 10 minutes. Transfer to a plate.

steps.title: Cook the onions
steps.body: Lower to medium and cook the onions, scraping up the browned bits, until soft and golden, 8 minutes.

steps.title: Braise
steps.body: Off the heat, stir in both paprikas for 30 seconds (they scorch easily), then add the tomato, pepper, stock, and 1/2 tsp salt. Return the chicken, cover, and braise on low until 175 F, 35 minutes.

steps.title: Cook the noodles
steps.body: While the chicken braises, salt the 4 quarts of boiling water with 1 tsp salt, cook the noodles until tender, 7 to 8 minutes, drain, and toss with the butter and parsley (overlap stated).

steps.title: Make the cucumber salad
steps.body: Also during the braise, toss the cucumbers with 1/2 tsp salt for 10 minutes, squeeze, and dress with the vinegar and sugar (overlap stated).

steps.title: Finish with sour cream
steps.body: Lift out the chicken. Whisk the flour into the sour cream, whisk in a ladle of the hot braising liquid to temper, then stir the mixture into the pan and heat gently without boiling until silky, 3 minutes. Return the chicken.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Serve the chicken and sauce over the buttered noodles with the cucumber salad.

equipment: 12-inch deep skillet or braiser with lid
